description: July 30 birthday meaning: Leo decan 1, birthday number 3, Life Path by year, Chinese zodiac note and famous birthdays.
answer: In Western astrology, a July 30 birthday falls in Leo, in the first decan, with Sun as the sign's ruler and Sun as the decan's. In numerology the day gives birthday number 3. The Life Path also uses the birth year. Leo is fixed and fire.

sections.heading: Personality of a July 30 birthday
paragraphs: Expression is the theme of the 30th of July. Leo, seven degrees along in its Sun-ruled first decan, loves a stage; 3, the number of creativity and communication, hands it a script. Tradition paints a playful, dramatic and warm personality who brightens gatherings. The deeper gift is often encouraging quieter people to take their turn in the light.

By noon UTC on July 30, the Sun has normally reached roughly 7° of Leo. That places the date in the Leo decan that astrologers give to Sun, the first of three. With the Sun ruling both the sign and its first decan, late-July birthdays sit in the most radiant part of Leo. This is traditionally the decan of presence: warmth, self-expression and a natural pull towards the centre of the stage or the head of the table. Generosity and loyalty are often strong, and so is a need to be appreciated for the effort behind the performance. The doubled solar tone can tip into wounded pride when recognition is withheld. These Lions usually shine brightest when their light is used to warm a whole group rather than only to illuminate themselves.

sections.heading: Numerology of the July 30 birthday
paragraphs: A birthday on the 30th reduces as 3 + 0 = 3. The 0 is often read as amplifying the 3, so this birthday number carries an extra dose of expression, imagination and social energy. Unlike the 12th or 21st, the compound contains only the 3 itself, which numerologists sometimes describe as creativity without dilution. Thirtieth-born people are frequently described as eloquent, entertaining and quick with ideas. As a secondary number, the 30 tends to shine in writing, speaking or performance. Focus is their usual challenge, since so many ideas compete for attention.

Because the year enters the Life Path calculation, the same July 30 birthday leads to different paths across generations, among them 1 for 1980, 11 for 1990, 3 for 2000 and 4 for 2010. Some birth years on this date reach the master number 11. The Life Path calculator does the reduction for any year.

sections.heading: July 30 in context: the season, Chinese zodiac and famous birthdays
paragraphs: July birthdays land in high summer north of the equator, with long warm evenings, and in midwinter in the southern hemisphere. Cancer holds the first three weeks, with Leo arriving around July 22 or 23. In numerology July is month 7, the number of reflection, analysis and inner life, which tends to give these birthdays a thoughtful, private layer beneath the summer brightness. July 30 is the 211st day of the year (212nd in a leap year). In most years Virgo season is under way by August 23, 24 days after this birthday.

Chinese astrology is straightforward for a July 30 birthday: the new year began weeks earlier, so the birth year's own animal applies. July 30 is also the birthday of Henry Ford (1863), Arnold Schwarzenegger (1947) and Emily Brontë (1818).

faq.question: What zodiac sign is July 30?
faq.answer: July 30 is Leo in every year from 1930 to 2030, wherever you were born. It falls in the first decan of Leo, which tradition links with Sun.

faq.question: What is the Life Path number for someone born on July 30?
faq.answer: It depends on the birth year. On July 30 the Life Path is 8 in 1960, 9 in 1970, 1 in 1980, 11 in 1990, 3 in 2000, 4 in 2010 and 5 in 2020. The birthday number, from the day alone, is 3 for everyone born on the 30th.

faq.question: What Chinese zodiac sign is someone born on July 30?
faq.answer: By July 30 the Chinese new year is well under way, which means the animal and element are those of the calendar birth year.

faq.question: Which famous people were born on July 30?
faq.answer: Among the best-known people with a July 30 birthday are Henry Ford (1863), Arnold Schwarzenegger (1947) and Emily Brontë (1818). The list comes from Wikidata and favours people with the most Wikipedia articles.
